status: DIAGNOSIS ONLY, no code changed. The cause is located and measured on two binaries; the fix needs one more producer trace, named below
classification: discovery; why no torpedo aircraft in this project has ever reached the aim tick
finding: All five of USN01's Mavs fly into the water at about 141 m/s roughly eleven seconds into the run. Every symptom the stream was chasing is downstream of that: the approach stops at 124 ticks because run_torpedo_task_arm_009d4850 returns on command_target_plus_one == 0 once the aircraft is gone; min == last == 3928.5 m because it closed 330.7 m and then died; aim_ticks=0 because the in-range latch wants range < 2200 m; and 009D2287, 007BBBA0 and 007EEF30 are all downstream of an aim stage that never runs. The heading error reached 0.000 rad, so steering was correct.
proximate_cause: The commanded run-in altitude is 12 m and the pitch demand is exactly -pi/3 rad, held from 800 m to the sea. The aim tick's floor is approach+78h + approach+74h at 009D1631: +78h is TorpReleaseAlt 12.0 (correct for what it is) and +74h is 0.00.
root_cause: 009D3489-009D34AE stores alt_floor_74 = ctl+398h only when ctl+398h < 100.0 (FLD [ECX+398h], FCOMIP against the double at 00D7A220, JBE skips). GameUnitsHost's read_control_block feeds that field kPilotTorpedoCruisingAltDefault = 500.0f, whose own comment says it is Pilot/Torpedo/CruisingAlt, the +394h key. 500 fails the gate, so +74h keeps its zero and the band collapses to the 12 m release altitude. The substitution has no producer behind it: 009D4A70 only READS the field (009D4B57 FLD [EAX+398h]) and stores nothing to +398h anywhere in its body.

Neither the dive bomb's cmd+2CCh planner change nor this lineage's plane-squadron wing moves any of them

next_step: Read 009C8920 BSP_BotTaskDiveBomb_UpdateCruiseProfile's store to +398h at 009C89CE and find which tuning key it takes; docs/DIVE_BOMB_TASK.md may already name it. Any value below 100 m makes 009D3489's store fire and the band becomes that value plus 12 m, which is a torpedo run-in altitude rather than a dive into the sea. The fix is one field in read_control_block and it must come from the producer, not from picking a number that passes the gate.
